name: expert-bootstrap
description: Bootstrap a project-local council of generated domain experts. Cross-platform: two meta-agents (prompt-engineer + project-manager) generate a tailored expert roster per project, written to ./.claude/agents/<name>.md on Claude Code or ./skills/<name>/SKILL.md on portable hosts (Codex CLI verified; Gemini CLI / OpenCode best-effort).

x-runtime-compatibility.notes: Verified end-to-end only on Claude Code. On other listed runtimes, generated agent files use standard frontmatter (name/description) and are designed to be portable, but the full pipeline (SKILL.md auto-discovery, Agent(subagent_type=...) dispatch, /plugin marketplace install) has not been validated by the maintainers. Reports from those hosts are welcome via GitHub issues.
